Interface PqFile

public interface PqFile

Value of a Parquet column annotated with the FILE logical type: a reference to a range of bytes, stored inline in the value or in an external object named by a URI.

The factories build only references the format defines:

Factory Refers to
inline(byte[]) the given bytes
external(String) the whole object at uri
external(String, long) bytes [0, size) of the object at uri
external(String, long, long) bytes [offset, offset + size) of the object at uri

withInline(byte[]), withContentType(String) and withChecksum(String) return a copy with one more field set.

PqFile photo = PqFile.external("s3://bucket/bundle.tar", 4096, 51200)
        .withContentType("image/png");

A FILE value is not resolved: fetching the object at uri() and verifying checksum() are left to the caller.

The values the factories and the reader return are immutable: the factories copy the arrays they are given, and inline() returns a copy on each call. Two such values are equal when their accessors return equal values, the inline bytes compared by content; neither is equal to an instance of another implementation. A value the reader returns can be held after the reader moves on; while it is reachable, the inline bytes of every value in the batch it was read from stay in memory. A writer checks every value it is given against the format's rules, whatever implements it.

      static PqFile external(String uri, long offset, long size)
      A reference to size bytes of the object at uri, starting at offset.
      Parameters:
      uri - an RFC 3986 URI-reference, absolute or relative, stored as given
      offset - the position of the first byte referenced
      size - the number of bytes referenced, 0 for none
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if uri is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if uri is empty, or offset or size is negative

    • withInline

      default PqFile withInline(byte[] bytes)
      Returns a copy of this reference that also stores bytes inline. Combined with external(String) it records where inline bytes came from; the two are expected to denote the same bytes, which is not checked.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if bytes is null
      IllegalStateException - if this reference already stores bytes inline

    • withContentType

      default PqFile withContentType(String mediaType)
      Returns a copy of this reference with the media type of the referenced bytes.
      Parameters:
      mediaType - an RFC 2046 media type, such as image/png
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if mediaType is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if mediaType is empty
      IllegalStateException - if this reference already has a content type

    • withChecksum

      default PqFile withChecksum(String token)
      Returns a copy of this reference with an integrity token for the referenced bytes, of the form <algorithm>:<digest>, such as SHA-256:… or an object store's ETAG:…. The token is stored as given and not verified against any bytes. The writer refuses a token not of that form, and one whose digest for MD5, CRC32, CRC32C or SHA-256 is not lowercase hex of that algorithm's length.
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if token is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if token is empty
      IllegalStateException - if this reference already has a checksum
